title: Fundamentals of Robotics, Sensors and Instrumentation

questions.q: According to ISO 8373, an industrial robot must be programmable in at least how many axes?
questions.explain: The definition requires three or more programmable axes.

questions.q: A bottling line that produces one product at very high volume is an example of:
questions.explain: Table 1.2: transfer and bottling lines are fixed automation.

questions.q: In a six-axis articulated robot, which joints mainly orient the tool?
questions.explain: The wrist (joints 4–6) orients the tool; joints 1–3 position the wrist centre.

questions.q: Arc welding of a curved seam requires which motion-control class?
questions.explain: The torch path between points must be controlled.

questions.q: Which configuration is selectively compliant in the horizontal plane and rigid vertically?
questions.explain: SCARA = Selective Compliance Assembly Robot Arm.

questions.q: Use Grübler's formula to find the DOF of a planar four-bar linkage (all revolute joints).
A cylindrical robot has r_min = 0.25 m, r_max = 0.75 m, vertical stroke 0.6 m and base rotation 300°. Compute the work volume.
A planar 2R arm has l₁ = 0.5 m and l₂ = 0.3 m. What is its minimum reach?
Re-teaching which frame relocates an entire palletising program to a new pallet?
questions.explain: Points are taught relative to the user frame.

questions.q: A 1024-line incremental encoder is read with ×4 decoding. What is its resolution in degrees?
A linear potentiometer (R_p = 10 kΩ, V_s = 10 V) feeds a 50 kΩ recorder with the wiper at x = 0.6. Find the output voltage.
An ultrasonic echo returns after 5.83 ms in air at 35 °C. What is the true distance?
In a load-cell weighing system, the Wheatstone bridge is the:
questions.explain: It converts the resistance change into a voltage.

questions.q: A thermometer with τ = 8 s at 25 °C is plunged into water at 100 °C. What does it read after 10 s?
A voltmeter of 1 MΩ measures a source with V_Th = 6 V and R_Th = 50 kΩ. What does it read?
Eight readings have mean 101.125 °C in a 100.0 °C bath and s = 0.225 °C. The instrument is:
questions.explain: Small spread (precise) but 1.125 °C bias (not accurate) – Example 1.8.

questions.q: Find the resistance of a Pt100 RTD at 150 °C using the Callendar–Van Dusen equation (A = 3.9083e-3, B = −5.775e-7).
A type K thermocouple reads 7.138 mV with the reference junction at 25 °C (E(25,0) = 1.000 mV, E(200,0) = 8.138 mV). What is the hot-junction temperature?
A mercury manometer (ρ = 13 546 kg/m³) shows h = 150 mm. Find Δp in kPa.
A full bridge with V_ex = 10 V, G_F = 2.0 measures 857 µε. What is the output in mV?
